subject: Credentials & training validation request — onboarding/offboarding evidence
messages:
From: Diane Sullivan <d.sullivan@cedarbank.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Brightline Audit Team <audits@brightline.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 scope (personnel controls)

Hi Markus,

As part of our SOC 2 scoping for CedarBank's upcoming attestation, the audit team needs a compact set of artifacts demonstrating your personnel lifecycle controls. Specifically we're looking for:

- The standard onboarding checklist used for new engineers and product staff (redacted PII is fine)
- A rollup of security training completion for the past 12 months (timestamps + course ids)
- A summary of background check outcomes / vendor confirmations (no full reports)
- Deprovisioning checklist for leavers and timing SLAs

Could you please provide a single archive or links to the items above by end of week? If you have a short narrative that explains expected timelines (e.g., BG checks completed within X days, access revoked within Y hours), include that as well.

If it's easier, feel free to send a minimal manifest and we'll follow up with targeted questions.

Thanks,
Diane Sullivan
Senior Information Security Manager
CedarBank

--
Attachment: requested_scoping_template.xlsx (Excel)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 scope (personnel controls)

Laura / Priyom / Grace,

Forwarding CedarBank's ask below. They want a compact evidence bundle for onboarding/offboarding and training. Brightline is cc'd. Can someone coordinate? Priority: provide an itemized package and a short narrative on timelines and controls.

Key constraints: we should not attach full PII or raw background reports. Redacted artifacts or CSV summaries are preferred.

Suggested owners: Priyom to pull onboarding and BG summaries, Laura to draft the narrative and access/revocation SLAs, Grace to confirm training rollup.

Markus

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 scope (personnel controls)

Thanks Markus — taking point on the narrative. Quick plan: 

1) I'll draft a 1-page narrative that covers: BG vendor used, typical BG timeline (offer to clearance metric), training cadence (required + optional), and deprovisioning SLA (target and measured).
2) Priyom: can you export the redacted onboarding checklist and a CSV with the most recent 18 months of BG outcomes (only columns: role, hire_month, bg_status) by end of day Thursday?
3) Grace: please produce the training completion rollup (course ids, completion date, % completion by role) and flag any overdue recerts.
4) We'll place everything in a shared folder and produce a short manifest linking each file.

Two quick notes: please avoid including copies of ID docs or criminal reports in the package — the auditor asked for summaries only. Also we'll sanitize manager comments from any exported notes.

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Sullivan <d.sullivan@cedarbank.com>, Brightline Audit Team <audits@brightline.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2028 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 scope (personnel controls)

Diane — thanks for the clear list. We delivered a compact evidence bundle and a short controls narrative. Summary: 

- onboarding_checklist_redacted.pdf — the standard checklist we use for new hires; PII redacted.
- bg-check-summary.csv — 18-month summary of background outcomes (columns: role, hire_month, bg_status).
- training_completion_rollup.xlsx — 12-month completion rollup (course ids, completion dates, % completion).
- narrative_control_summary.txt — 1-page narrative describing vendor, timelines and deprovisioning SLA.

Access: the files are in a limited Google Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC3_example_onboarding_pack. We also linked the manifest to SEC-412 in our tracker for audit follow-up.

Key controls narrative highlights (summary):
- Background checks: vendor is SecureCheck Inc.; standard turnaround ~3-7 business days; escalations flagged to HR for manual review.
- Training: mandatory security baseline required within 14 days of start; annual recertification.
- Deprovisioning: access to primary systems revoked within 2 hours of HR termination notification for active accounts; secondary systems within 24 hours.

Please let us know if the CedarBank audit team needs any further granularity. We are happy to provide an access window for review or to export additional metrics.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: training_completion_rollup.xlsx (Excel), narrative_control_summary.txt (Text)
